fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Skin notes on Wren's screen the night before

Thistle Skin Studio sends the intake link with every first-facial booking. Lena Cho answers the day she books, noting combination skin and a fragrance allergy. The evening before, esthetician Wren Ito gets an email with those answers for the 10:00 facial. They stay on Lena's profile for later visits.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { firstFacials: "I run Thistle Skin Studio. Build an esthetician intake form that goes out with every first-facial booking confirmation. Ask for skin type, the products the client uses morning and night, any allergies, and their top skin goal. The evening before the appointment, email the esthetician a card with that client's answers, and keep everything on the client's profile.", returningClients: "Build an intake form for returning clients at Birchwood Day Spa. Open it with last visit's answers already filled in, so the client only edits what changed, and mark each change on their record for the front desk. If the last full intake is more than 12 months old, open the form blank instead.", medSpaIntake: "My business is Calla Med Spa, and we use one intake form for every service. Add a health history section. If a client answers yes to any question there, put the booking on hold and send our nurse practitioner, Bea Marsh, a card with the record to review. Show the front desk which bookings are on hold.", videoConsults: "I'm a solo esthetician running Fern Mobile Facials. Build a consultation form for my free 15-minute video consults. Ask the client for three photos taken in daylight, one from the front and one from each side, and their top concern from a short list. Save the photos with the request so I can look at them before the call." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build an esthetician intake form that saves every response to a database I own.

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: A first-facial intake at Thistle Skin Studio records combination skin and a fragrance allergy, and an email gives esthetician Wren Ito those answers for Lena Cho's 10:00 facial.
